en.html:
I chased her.

The horo creaked.
Every joint in my body screamed.

Scream, then.
Enough strength for one more stroke. That was all I needed.

One stroke.
Into that silver.

Too fast.
Too far.

So what?

I would chase.
I would catch her.

Catch those wings—
Drag her down—

Cut.
Cut her down!

en.html:
The silver figure reached the edge of the heavens.
No reaching her now. No possibility.

A world for her alone. A palace in the moon.
She ruled that place with all a queen's dignity.

And the silver warrior sang a verse.
